title: REQ · Generated manifest declares boy animations with frame ranges and rates
summary: art:generate writes the boy PNGs and manifest entries with animations and origin
description: Context: generateAssets emits image or spritesheet entries without animations or origin, and mergeManifest replaces by id. ART_SOURCES holds only the cursor. Desired: ArtSource optionally carries animations and origin, generateAssets copies them, and ART_SOURCES includes the boy sources so npm run art:generate writes PNGs and manifest entries. Expected: manifest has character:boy-art (448x48, idle 0-3, walk 4-9, interact 10-13) and character:boy-portrait (32x32). Why: Done-when requires the manifest to declare animations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a source with animations and origin, when generateAssets runs, then the entry includes them unchanged
Given the committed manifest, when parsed with parseManifest, then it is valid and idle, walk, interact have frames [0-3], [4-9], [10-13] with frameRates
Given ART_SOURCES, when listed, then it contains the boy sheet and portrait ids

preserve: existing manifest entries and SVG paths
sources without animations behave as before

technical_constraints: Deterministic generation script; no downloaded art
Keep data-driven content; no ids hardcoded in scenes
definition_of_done: npm run art:generate produces PNGs and a valid manifest
